findings.detail: Phase 2 can ingest owner intent and completion criteria, create and version requirements, track assumptions, decisions and invariants, hash structured specification state, detect simple contradictions, and replay exact state from append-only receipts.

Owner-controlled records require A3, ordinary specification records require A2, missing evidence remains UNKNOWN, invalid lifecycle movement fails closed, and protected authority documents are unchanged.
SQLite persistence, discovery acceptance, model reasoning, and the Architect-Builder-Auditor loop remain correctly deferred.
PR review repairs prevent lifecycle bypass, require every named evidence obligation, normalize malformed ledger failures into ForgeError, and remove unapproved protected governance mutation.
Product Brain state is private behind read-only snapshots and copies, while requirement creation, versioning, and transitions enforce each requirement's declared authority without downgrade.

Signed owner grants bind every A3 mutation; failed mutations roll back state and receipts; replay enforces original authority; tuple canonicalization prevents caller mutation; malformed and blank records fail closed.
Version-one requirements cannot claim prior lineage, and invariants require nonblank identity, statement, authority, and verification references.
